title: Job Board Delta
tagline: Job Board Delta is a new fun way to hunt for jobs in Web3 using FVM
description: The Job Board Delta project has been built to enable users to apply for jobs in Web3 and get directly rewarded by employers for their applications. Selected users are given rewards on jobs that they have applied for whilst leveraging IPFS to store decentralized data. Rewards are sent cross chain using Squid Router to transmit reward tokens to the destination chain
how_its_made: This project is built on FEVM, has the host EVM, Squid Router for cross chain payments, and Fleek to host the front end of the job board. The project leverages Metamask and ethers.js to integrate FEVM to the front end. The project leverages Openzeppelin to implement the reward token.
